title: Public Chatticus wiki mirrors internal planning docs with Kanbus ticket IDs and "name TBD"
description:
**Problem**
About 20 pages under chattic.us/wiki are generated from internal planning documents and expose Kanbus ticket IDs, 'name TBD' placeholders and planning scratch. The wiki pages are generated from Chatticus docs/, so the fix belongs in the docs/wiki publishing selection.

**Evidence**
Examples of mirrored internal docs: python-retirement-scenarios, owner-credential-* pages, FEASIBILITY_TESTS.md, spec-coverage-baseline.md (all under docs/). Pages contain ticket IDs such as TS-61 and the text 'name TBD'.

**Fix**
Add an allowlist (or exclude list) to the wiki generator so only user-facing docs publish; scrub ticket IDs and TBD placeholders from anything that stays public.

**How to verify**
Crawl https://chattic.us/wiki: no page contains a Kanbus ticket ID pattern (e.g. TS-[0-9]+) or the string 'name TBD', and the internal planning pages above return 404.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
